race.description: Melb Cup Packages Now On Sale Mdn Plate
race.comment: APOCALYPSE (11) didn't fire on debut at Ballarat but was kept safe in betting in a stronger maiden. He was only beaten four lengths there and should be a sharp improver for the McEvoy yard who find a nice race second time out. BACK UP BARBIE (5) has been right there in two runs back, up in trip at Echuca second up and boxing on well for fourth. Peaks now and has solid claims. PEACE SEEKER (10) can mix form a bit, okay last time at Echuca in the same race as BACK UP BARBIE. Form prior was solid for this.TED PERCY (4) is ticking along nicely to begin his career and appears to be building towards a win. Finds a suitable race today.
